items.exampleEn: Should schools do away with homework altogether?
items.exampleZh: 學校應該完全廢除回家作業嗎？

items.exampleEn: In difficult times, people draw on their inner strength.
items.exampleZh: 在困難的時候，人們會憑藉內心的力量。

items.exampleEn: We are about to embark on something new.
items.exampleZh: 我們即將開始一件新的事情。

items.exampleEn: When you plan a long drive, factor in delays.
items.exampleZh: 規劃長途開車時，要把延誤納入考量。

items.exampleEn: Her rough notes were later fleshed out into a book.
items.exampleZh: 她粗略的筆記後來被充實成一本書。

items.exampleEn: The small team held out until the very end of the match.
items.exampleZh: 這支小隊伍一直堅持到比賽的最後一刻。

items.exampleEn: The club's first members laid these rules down long ago.
items.exampleZh: 社團最早的成員很久以前就制定了這些規則。

items.sentenceEn: This report draws on data from ten countries.
items.sentenceZh: 這份報告利用了十個國家的資料。

items.audioEn: Our neighbors held out for months, but in the end they sold their house to the builders.
items.audioZh: 我們的鄰居撐了好幾個月，但最後還是把房子賣給了建商。
options: They finally agreed to move out

items.sentenceEn: We forgot to factor the parking cost in.
items.sentenceZh: 我們忘了把停車費算進去。

items.sentenceEn: My sister embarked on a trip around the world.
items.sentenceZh: 我的姊妹展開了一趟環遊世界的旅行。

items.stemEn: Many companies have ____ paper tickets and now use phones instead.
items.stemZh: 很多公司已經廢除紙本票券，改用手機。

items.stemEn: Your essay has a good structure, but you need to ____ the main points with examples.
items.stemZh: 你的文章架構不錯，但需要用例子充實主要論點。

items.passageEn: When the writer Mei Ling embarked on her first novel, she had only a rough idea of the story. She drew on memories of her grandmother's small village, and over two years she fleshed the characters out one by one. Her publisher laid down strict rules about length and set a tight deadline, which she found stressful at first. However, she held out against pressure to change the sad ending, because she believed it was true to the story. The book was finally published last spring and has already been translated into four languages. Critics have praised its honest picture of village life.
items.passageZh: 作家 Mei Ling 著手寫第一本小說時，對故事只有一個粗略的想法。她利用了對祖母那個小村莊的回憶，花了兩年一個一個把角色寫得更豐滿。出版社對篇幅定下了嚴格的規定，也訂了很緊的截止日期，一開始讓她覺得壓力很大。不過，面對要她改掉悲傷結局的壓力，她堅持不改，因為她相信那樣的結局才忠於故事。這本書終於在去年春天出版，而且已經被翻譯成四種語言。評論家都稱讚它真實描繪了鄉村生活。

questions.questionZh: 作者寫小說時參考了什麼？
options: 出版社給她的一份故事大綱
她在國外旅行時寫的日記
一部有名的老電影的劇情

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼不肯改結局？
options: 出版社說改了會拖延出書的時間
她認為悲傷的結局才符合故事

items.promptZh: 這家公司去年廢除了服裝規定。
referenceEn: The company did away with its dress code last year.
Last year, the company did away with the dress code.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「廢除」（例如 did away with the dress code 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 abolished、scrapped、got rid of、dropped its dress code 等）
有「去年」，用過去式（例如 did away with 等）
「服裝規定」可寫，例如 dress code、rules about clothes 等

referenceEn: He held out his hand to shake mine.
He held his hand out to shake my hand.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「伸出」（例如 held out his hand、held his hand out 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 put out、reached out、extended、offered his hand 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 held out、has held out 等）
「握手」可寫，例如 shake mine、shake my hand 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：draw on 的干擾項「穿上」其實是 draw on 的字典義（draw on one's gloves/boots＝穿上、戴上）；「持續」也接近 draw on 的時間義（as the night drew on＝時間推移）。兩者都是該片語的另一個意思，建議換成無關片語（如 draw up 以外的其他義）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：draw on 干擾項「持續」「穿上」（draw on 的其他字典義）換成「拒絕」「延後」
